entries.brief: Create ONE original square painterly fantasy encyclopedia portrait for SKAZ: young black dragon. Subject: sleek charcoal-black scales, narrow crocodilian skull, two smooth forward-curving ivory horns, small neck frill. Show a young yet dangerous dragon, NOT a hatchling: slim neck, smaller smooth horns, unscarred fine scales, lighter jaw than an ancient dragon. Three-quarter head and upper neck facing LEFT. Broad sculpted brush shapes, moderate detail, strong unique silhouette readable at 32 and 40 pixels. Soft warm upper-left light, natural restrained materials, strong dark and light edge contrast. Entire head, all horns and upper neck INSIDE frame with at least 8 percent clear transparent padding on every edge, portrait occupies 75 percent of square. Isolated TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No scenery, fog, mist, glow halo, smoke, background paint or shadow, frame, text, numbers, symbols or weapons. Original artwork, not copied from any published illustration.
